instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: Both water and metal conduct electricity.
It is safe to use electrical appliances in the bathroom.
It is very dangerous to swim in the sea during a storm.
The safest place to stand during a storm is under a tree.
It is safe to fly a kite near an electricity pylon.
It is safe to use damaged wires.

instruction.text: Match the rule to the correct picture.

atoms.a: Never stick a fork into a toaster.
atoms.b: Never stick a fork into a toaster.

atoms.a: Never use an electric device with wet hands.
atoms.b: Never use an electric device with wet hands.

atoms.a: Is Becca’s laptop in a safe place?
What advice would you give to Becca to help her avoid electrocution?
b: ++It is best to keep electrical appliances out of the bathroom because there is a large risk of them getting wet.
It is best to keep electrical appliances out of the bathroom because they might distract you.

instruction.text: The weather is stormy. Fill in the gaps with the safest thing for Ellie to do.

atoms.b: Ellie would like to go swimming in the lake near her house. She should ((++wait_until_the_storm_has_cleared just_go_anyway)).
Swimming in water outdoors is dangerous during a thunderstorm because ((++water_conducts_electricity the_fish_get_scared_and_will_attack)).
Ellie does not like the rain, so she would like to take cover. She should ((++go_to_a_building stand_under_a_tree)).
